relationships.subject: miR-15a-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: Bcl-2 was targeted and downregulated by miR-15a-5p.

relationships.subject: miR-15a-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: MiR-15a-5p mimics also elevated MCP-1 and MMP-9 protein expressions, which were inhibited by Bcl-2 upregulation.

relationships.subject: Ang II
relationships.evidence_quote: Ang II treatment not only accelerated VSMCs viability and migratory abilities, but also upregulated MCP-1 and MMP-9 protein expressions.

key_findings: Ang II induced miR-15a-5p, which targets and downregulates Bcl-2 in VSMCs.
miR-15a-5p promoted VSMC viability, migration and MCP-1/MMP-9 expression via Bcl-2.
